row.body:
Hello Harbor Lane Café,

Invoice INV-1042 for $4,800.00 was due on August 17, 2026, and is now 45 days past due. Please arrange payment within 7 days, or reply to let us know when we can expect it.

Regards,
Ember & Oak Coffee Roasters
row.subject: Payment overdue: invoice INV-1042 ($4,800.00)

row.body:
Hello Verde Green Coffee Imports,

We have paid all 12 of our recent invoices to you on time, and we value the relationship. To smooth our cash flow over the coming weeks, could you extend our payment terms from net 14 to net 44 days, starting with invoices issued from October 1, 2026? Please let us know whether this works for you.

Kind regards,
Ember & Oak Coffee Roasters
